defects.description: The `return if order.shipped?` and `return if items.empty?` guards were removed from ShipOrderJob#perform, so Carrier.create_shipment runs on every call. RetryScheduler#run in app/jobs/retry_scheduler.rb re-enqueues the job whenever perform raises (for example when order.update! fails after the shipment was created), so the retry books a second shipment, and an order with no items also gets a shipment.
